environment.description: Original bounded Claude environment-building agent and Docker execution-feedback loop

tests.description: Native pre/post execution snapshots and state-based test generation

repair.description: Original repair mode resumes an incomplete refiner; requires existing refinement metadata

refine.description: Original refiner with oracle, NOP and partial trials; preserves pre-refinement draft
